name: Ba Be to Cao Bang
summary: Go by road. Coaches on the Hanoi–Cao Bang line often pass the lake, or you can hire a car or van at Ba Be. There is no rail or air link at either end.

modes.note: Coaches on the Hanoi–Cao Bang line often pass the lake (VnExpress). Where to board and when was not printed. Ask at your homestay.
Wikivoyage says cars and vans of 4 to 45 seats can be booked through the Ba Be tourism centre. Kilometres and minutes for this leg were not on an official page.

seoTitle: Ba Be to Cao Bang — bus or hired car
seoDescription: Ba Be Lake to Cao Bang is a road trip: Hanoi–Cao Bang coaches that pass the lake, or a car or van hired at Ba Be.

faqs.q: Is there a train or a flight?
faqs.a: No. No station is named for the park, Cao Bằng has no rail connection, and no airport is named at either end.

faqs.q: Can I do it the other way, Cao Bang to Ba Be?
faqs.a: Yes. Ba Be sits between Cao Bằng and Hà Nội, so it works as a stop on the way back south. Check the bus on arrival.
